## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What’s the best home security system?
  
  Every home and family is different, and a Brinks Home security system is tailored to your unique
  needs. Our Security Consultants work with you to design a system that fits your lifestyle.
* ### How much does a full home security system cost? 
  
  We have options to fit every budget, including the ability to buy now and pay later with as little
  as 0% down at the time of purchase for qualified applicants**. We offer free professional
  installation* and may have promotions to help you save. Speak with a Security Consultant to learn
  more. 
* ### Are home security systems worth it? 
  
  A security system for home enhances safety and helps deter break-ins. Brinks Home systems combine
  comprehensive protection with smart home functionality in an all-in-one integrated hub. Plus, a
  professionally monitored security system can save you money on homeowners insurance. 
* ### Do I need professional installation?
  
  Professional installation ensures that your system and devices are set up properly and connected
  to our monitoring center. Brinks Home Installation Technicians bring extensive knowledge to handle
  all components and assess your specific needs. They’ll walk you through everything so you feel
  confident and secure. 
* ### How does home alarm monitoring work? 
  
  Home alarm monitoring connects your security system to a professional monitoring center. When an
  alarm is triggered, the system sends a signal to Brinks Home’s 24/7 Alarm Response Center. Our
  trained professionals quickly verify the alarm and take necessary action—such as contacting you or
  dispatching emergency services.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What’s the best home security system?
  
  Every home and family is different, and a Brinks Home security system is tailored to your unique
  needs. Our Security Consultants work with you to design a system that fits your lifestyle.
* ### How much does a full home security system cost? 
  
  We have options to fit every budget, including the ability to buy now and pay later with as little
  as 0% down at the time of purchase for qualified applicants**. We offer free professional
  installation* and may have promotions to help you save. Speak with a Security Consultant to learn
  more. 
* ### Are home security systems worth it? 
  
  A security system for home enhances safety and helps deter break-ins. Brinks Home systems combine
  comprehensive protection with smart home functionality in an all-in-one integrated hub. Plus, a
  professionally monitored security system can save you money on homeowners insurance. 
* ### Do I need professional installation?
  
  Professional installation ensures that your system and devices are set up properly and connected
  to our monitoring center. Brinks Home Installation Technicians bring extensive knowledge to handle
  all components and assess your specific needs. They’ll walk you through everything so you feel
  confident and secure. 
* ### How does home alarm monitoring work? 
  
  Home alarm monitoring connects your security system to a professional monitoring center. When an
  alarm is triggered, the system sends a signal to Brinks Home’s 24/7 Alarm Response Center. Our
  trained professionals quickly verify the alarm and take necessary action—such as contacting you or
  dispatching emergency services.

***Offer Terms & Conditions**

All offers are subject to availability and may not be available in all states, provinces, or zip
codes. Taxes and additional fees may apply.

**HomeProtect Offer Terms**

Vivint’s standard HomeProtect package includes 1 Vivint Security Hub, 3 Vivint Door & Window
Sensors, 1 Vivint Motion Sensor, 1 Vivint Keypad, and 1 Vivint yard sign. The HomeProtect equipment
package is regularly priced at $349.99, with professional installation priced at $199 and Vivint
system monitoring at $29.99/mo., unless otherwise advertised. Offer for new Vivint customers only.

**HomeProtect Pro Offer Terms **

The HomeProtect Pro Offer is available to new and existing Vivint customers and requires a minimum
$749.99 expenditure on equipment (after discounts), professional installation and execution of a
Vivint services agreement. Monthly service fees vary based on the products and services you select.
HomeProtect system purchases and reactivations of previously-installed systems are not eligible for
this offer.

**Financing Options**

Financing for equipment purchases is subject to credit approval by one of Vivint’s third-party
financing partners. Qualified customers may finance at 0% APR for up to 60 months, with terms
varying by offer. Financing requires a separate agreement with the financing partner. Month-to-month
service agreements are available when equipment is purchased upfront.

**Vivint Systems & Services**

System can support multiple cameras, subject to sufficient WiFi speeds. Without a Vivint services
plan, product and system functionality is limited (including loss of remote connectivity). Contact a
Vivint representative for complete equipment, services, and pricing details. Products and services
in Louisiana provided by Vivint Louisiana Commercial Certificate #58280. See Vivint license numbers
[here][126]. Click [here][127] for full terms of service.

## Locally Owned and Operated

As a [local New Orleans company][57] with over 20 years of experience, ABC Fire and Burglar Alarm,
LLC is dedicated to protecting families and businesses in our community. We proudly service the New
Orleans metropolitan area including New Orleans, Metairie, Kenner, Destrehan, Luling, Houma, Gretna,
Belle Chasse, Chalmette, Slidell, Covington, Hammond, Laplace, and surrounding areas

## Alarm Monitoring

Protect what matters most with 24/7 professional alarm monitoring and emergency response. Our
security systems are monitored by a licensed central monitoring station, which is UL listed, FM
approved, IQ certified, TMA Five Diamond certified, and has been named Monitoring Station of the
Year. Our alarm monitoring is hot-redundant (staffed 24/7), and load-sharing (alarms are handled by
the first available dispatcher from all of our monitoring stations), and work together to provide a
level of redundancy that is unmatched in the industry.

[Residential Alarm Systems][Residential Alarm Systems]
[Home Automation Security System][Home Automation Security System]

## Residential Alarm Systems

ABC Fire & Burglar Alarm offers [residential alarm systems][58] that help to keep your home safe and
secure. Already have an alarm system? We can take over most existing systems and save you money on
monitoring. Want to upgrade or add to your existing alarm system? We can help with that too and save
you money on your monitoring. You can also save up to 20% on your homeowners’ insurance with a
monitored alarm system.

## Commercial Alarm Systems

Protect your business with a professionally installed [commercial alarm system][59] from ABC Fire
and Burglar Alarm. Our commercial alarm system allows you to conveniently monitor and control your
business through a single, mobile-friendly interface. We also provide monitored fire protection
(non-required fire). Stay informed and connected with what is happening at your business.

[Commercial Automation Security System][Commercial Automation Security System]
[Residential Alarm Systems][Residential Alarm Systems]

## Security Cameras

Protect what matters most with professionally installed [residential][60] and [commercial][61]
security camera systems from ABC Fire and Burglar Alarm. Our security camera systems allow you to
stay connected and in the know of what is going on at your residential or business at all times.

## Smart Home Solutions

Our “smart” system is not just an alarm system, you can control locks, lights, thermostats, and the
garage door. With our [residential][62] and [commercial][63] smart devices, you will have a “smart”
home or business that can be controlled from wherever you are which will make your life easier!

[Residential Alarms and monitoring Systems][Residential Alarms and monitoring Systems]

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

Our Expertise

## Comprehensive IT & Security Solutions

As a premier system integrator, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions tailored to your needs

### Cybersecurity Services

Red Team Operations, Penetration Testing, Blue Team Defense, Incident Response, and 24/7 SOC
monitoring to protect your organization from sophisticated threats.

[ Explore Services ][14]

### Network Solutions

Enterprise network design, architecture, security, wireless solutions, and LAN/WAN management with
multi-vendor expertise and best practices.

[ Explore Services ][15]

### IT Infrastructure

Cloud services, virtualization, server & storage solutions, IT consultancy, and managed IT services
for optimal performance and reliability.

[ Explore Services ][16]

### Governance, Risk & Compliance

ISO 27001, NCA ECC, GDPR, SOC2 compliance, policy development, security audits, and comprehensive
risk assessments.

[ Explore Services ][17]

Custom web applications, mobile apps for iOS and Android, progressive web apps, and full-stack
development with modern frameworks.

User-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, design systems, and usability testing
for exceptional digital experiences.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

property and assets by providing an early warning of an attempted break-in.

benefits of both. They are suitable for larger properties that require a mix of both types of

and scaring off intruders. They do not notify the authorities or a monitoring center, so the
homeowner must respond to the alarm themselves.

**Monitored Alarms:** These alarms are connected to a monitoring center, which is notified when the
alarm is triggered. The monitoring center can then notify the authorities, fire department or
medical services, depending on the type of emergency. This provides an additional level of
protection and peace of mind for the homeowner.

**Smart Alarms:** These alarms are connected to the internet and can be controlled and monitored
remotely using a smartphone app. They may also include features such as video cameras, motion
sensors and home automation integration.

The most suitable type of burglar alarm depends on the specific needs of the property owner, such as
the size and layout of the property, budget, and desired level of protection.

## **What do you call a burglar alarm?**

A burglar alarm is typically referred to as a security alarm or an intruder alarm. It is also
sometimes called a burglar alarm system, an alarm system, or a home security system. The term
“burglar alarm” specifically refers to the function of the device, which is to detect and deter

# Burglar Alarms

## Intruder and Security Alarm Installation

**[Burglar Alarms - Home Alarms:][146]** If you are looking into the installation of a home alarm
system it might be useful to know that the crime rate in Great Britain has been soaring annually.
Over the course of the year 2018-2019 there were over a million burglaries and robbery attempts in
the UK, with four hundred and twenty two thousand robberies reported in England and Wales alone.
(Source: Statista, Crime and Law Enforcement figures).

[[Free UK Burglar Alarm Quotes]][147]

Regrettably, it remains common for individuals to consider implementing an intruder detection system
or burglar alarm only after experiencing a break-in. The statistics reveal that in the UK, 47% of
burglaries are categorised as opportunistic by law enforcement. Consequently, their recommendation
is to proactively discourage potential criminals by equipping your residence or enterprise with an
alarm system. Shield yourself from the emotional distress and anxiety inflicted by a burglary by
investing in a security system tailored to the specific needs of your property. However, given the
wide array of intruder alarms available, determining the ideal choice can be a challenging task.

[Burglar Alarms UK]

Security and alarm systems cater to a wide range of budgets. For those with ample resources, a
specialized security provider can professionally install, maintain, and diligently monitor your
alarm system. On the opposite end of the spectrum, there are straightforward battery-powered systems
that can be set up and activated within minutes. Additionally, you'll find options in both wireless
and wired configurations. Many of these systems can seamlessly integrate with CCTV for capturing
potential intruders on camera for later identification. Before making your security alarm
investment, it's prudent to carefully consider its intended purpose.

### TYPES OF BURGLAR ALARM

**Audible/Visual Only Burglar Alarms** - These alarms are restricted to an internal or external bell
and/or a visual indicator showing that the alarm's been set off. This alarm notifies occupants and
neighbours but does not report the occurrence via text or voice message to a cell phone.

Pros:
* Easy installment can be achieved by an individual with DIY capabilities.
* The actual alarm box is a visual deterrent which can help to discourage would be intruders.

Cons:
* Recognition of the alarm is confined to those in or near to the property or building.
* False alarms in past times have rendered people "alarm immune".

[Burglar Alarm Installation UK]

**Auto-Dial Security Alarms** - These have all the features of a visual audio alarm, but is also
able to send a SMS text via a prepaid SIM card or dial out via a landline to send a recorded voice
message. This permits the alarm control unit to deliver a text or voice message to predetermined
contacts with some systems allowing several contacts to be included in a cascade system of phoning.
If multiple contacts are used then if the first one does not acknowledge the warning then the second
one on the list is informed, and so forth until verification.

Pros:
* An alarm activation will immediately send a notification to warn a contact.
* Supplemental sensors can be added to warn you of flooding, carbon monoxide or fire.

**Cons:**
* You need to have your mobile with you at all times, turned on and be in an area with a good signal
  to receive a message from the device.
* There must always be plenty of credit on the SIM card inserted in the alarm's control panel.

[[Burglar Alarms Quotes in the UK]][148]

**Monitored Alarm Systems** - By paying an annual or a monthly fee you are able to have your burglar
alarm constantly monitored by a specialist security company. The company will get in touch when the
alarm is triggered to give assistance, and will generally install and maintain the equipment as an
integral part of the package. These can also be linked to a police response unit for increased
security.

Pros:
* **
  
  24 / 7 monitoring and response by a professional team of alarm and security specialists.
  
  The security monitoring company will frequently provide alarm maintenance and repair as part of
  the package.
  
  The additional security measures of monitored alarms discourage criminals.
  
  **

Cons:
* **
  
  Can prove very expensive for some.
  
  Costly cancellation fees and lengthy contract periods.
  
  You're unable to set up this kind of burglar alarm yourself.
  
  **

[Alarm Systems UK - Home Alarm Installation]

**Smart Home Security Systems** - Using a combination of cameras and sensors it is possible to get
twenty four hour coverage of your home or business from anywhere across the world. Using a secure
application and personal account you've got the ability to control and view every aspect of your
alarm and security system from your compatible iOS device, Windows or Android.

Pros:
* The app and software can be used with several digital devices, like smartphones, laptops and
  tablets.
* An effective way to monitor your home or office if you travel a lot.

Cons:
* The costs can increase quickly if more detectors and sensors are needed than are contained in the
  standard package.
* Poor internet speeds can have an impact on the reliability of your alarm.

**Portable Alarms** - These battery powered devices add extra security cover in places where
short-term burglar alrms are needed. If you are using these for outbuilding security look for
independent systems which have a rechargeable battery and solar power option.

Pros:
* Just the thing for travelers who are always on the move who need to add an additional layer of
  security to a hotel room.
* Cheap, and the easiest to install of all the alarm systems.

Cons:
* Fairly basic security which only provides a local alarm in case of a break-in.
* Batteries need to be changed frequently.

### WIRELESS OR WIRED ALARMS?

[Intruder Alarm Installation UK]

How do you ascertain whether to opt for a wireless or wired burglar alarm, once you have decided
what your exact security needs are?

**Wired** - Generally, opting for a wired alarm system is more cost-effective than its wireless
counterpart, offering an equivalent level of security. However, the initial installation may incur
higher expenses due to the extensive labour involved in embedding the cables within your home. A
hard-wired alarm system boasts ease of maintenance and low operational costs, relying solely on
mains electricity to function efficiently. Regular upkeep is minimal, primarily involving the
cleaning of sensors and periodic checks of the battery backup in both the external bell box and the
control unit, following the schedule recommended by the alarm manufacturer. Nevertheless, if the
wiring is not meticulously concealed, it can detract from the aesthetic appeal of your home by
appearing unsightly.

**Wireless** - The cost of wireless alarm systems has significantly decreased from their initial
introduction, rendering them more affordable than they once were. Additionally, their installation
has become far simpler, allowing individuals with only fundamental DIY skills to set up a wireless
system with minimal hassle. To ensure optimal performance, it is advisable to keep a stock of
high-quality batteries available for the bell box and sensors, replacing them according to the
manufacturer's instructions for continued efficiency.

[[Quotes for Burglar Alarms in the UK]][149]

### INSTALLATION

For the best results, always hire an established alarm installer to install and set-up your burglar
system. You can find numerous burglar alarm companies and installers in the UK area who'll help you
in selecting a system to meet your requirements.

A professional UK burglar alarm installer will carefully consider your requirements and provide
options that satisfy your needs. This will entail an on-site survey to determine any access points
which will need to be covered, along with improvements that could be made to existing window and
door locks if necessary.

[Burglar Alarm System UK]

Speak to your home or business insurer before installation, to determine if there may be a reduction
on your policy for an approved intruder alarm on your home. If you're able to satisfy your insurers
burglar alarm recommendations, you could be pleasantly surprised to receive a special discount on
your policy.

Over the course of the year 2018-2019 there were over a million burglaries and robbery attempts in
the UK, with four hundred and twenty two thousand robberies reported in England and Wales alone.
(Source: Statista, Crime and Law Enforcement figures).

[[Free UK Burglar Alarm Quotes]][147]

Regrettably, it remains common for individuals to consider implementing an intruder detection system
or burglar alarm only after experiencing a break-in. The statistics reveal that in the UK, 47% of
burglaries are categorised as opportunistic by law enforcement. Consequently, their recommendation
is to proactively discourage potential criminals by equipping your residence or enterprise with an
alarm system. Shield yourself from the emotional distress and anxiety inflicted by a burglary by
investing in a security system tailored to the specific needs of your property. However, given the
wide array of intruder alarms available, determining the ideal choice can be a challenging task.

[Burglar Alarms UK]

Security and alarm systems cater to a wide range of budgets. For those with ample resources, a
specialized security provider can professionally install, maintain, and diligently monitor your
alarm system. On the opposite end of the spectrum, there are straightforward battery-powered systems
that can be set up and activated within minutes. Additionally, you'll find options in both wireless
and wired configurations. Many of these systems can seamlessly integrate with CCTV for capturing
potential intruders on camera for later identification. Before making your security alarm
investment, it's prudent to carefully consider its intended purpose.

### TYPES OF BURGLAR ALARM

**Audible/Visual Only Burglar Alarms** - These alarms are restricted to an internal or external bell
and/or a visual indicator showing that the alarm's been set off. This alarm notifies occupants and
neighbours but does not report the occurrence via text or voice message to a cell phone.

Pros:
* Easy installment can be achieved by an individual with DIY capabilities.
* The actual alarm box is a visual deterrent which can help to discourage would be intruders.

Cons:
* Recognition of the alarm is confined to those in or near to the property or building.
* False alarms in past times have rendered people "alarm immune".

[Burglar Alarm Installation UK]

**Auto-Dial Security Alarms** - These have all the features of a visual audio alarm, but is also
able to send a SMS text via a prepaid SIM card or dial out via a landline to send a recorded voice
message. This permits the alarm control unit to deliver a text or voice message to predetermined
contacts with some systems allowing several contacts to be included in a cascade system of phoning.
If multiple contacts are used then if the first one does not acknowledge the warning then the second
one on the list is informed, and so forth until verification.

Pros:
* An alarm activation will immediately send a notification to warn a contact.
* Supplemental sensors can be added to warn you of flooding, carbon monoxide or fire.

**Cons:**
* You need to have your mobile with you at all times, turned on and be in an area with a good signal
  to receive a message from the device.
* There must always be plenty of credit on the SIM card inserted in the alarm's control panel.

[[Burglar Alarms Quotes in the UK]][148]

**Monitored Alarm Systems** - By paying an annual or a monthly fee you are able to have your burglar
alarm constantly monitored by a specialist security company. The company will get in touch when the
alarm is triggered to give assistance, and will generally install and maintain the equipment as an
integral part of the package. These can also be linked to a police response unit for increased
security.

Pros:
* **
  
  24 / 7 monitoring and response by a professional team of alarm and security specialists.
  
  The security monitoring company will frequently provide alarm maintenance and repair as part of
  the package.
  
  The additional security measures of monitored alarms discourage criminals.
  
  **

Cons:
* **
  
  Can prove very expensive for some.
  
  Costly cancellation fees and lengthy contract periods.
  
  You're unable to set up this kind of burglar alarm yourself.
  
  **

[Alarm Systems UK - Home Alarm Installation]

**Smart Home Security Systems** - Using a combination of cameras and sensors it is possible to get
twenty four hour coverage of your home or business from anywhere across the world. Using a secure
application and personal account you've got the ability to control and view every aspect of your
alarm and security system from your compatible iOS device, Windows or Android.

Pros:
* The app and software can be used with several digital devices, like smartphones, laptops and
  tablets.
* An effective way to monitor your home or office if you travel a lot.

Cons:
* The costs can increase quickly if more detectors and sensors are needed than are contained in the
  standard package.
* Poor internet speeds can have an impact on the reliability of your alarm.

**Portable Alarms** - These battery powered devices add extra security cover in places where
short-term burglar alrms are needed. If you are using these for outbuilding security look for
independent systems which have a rechargeable battery and solar power option.

Pros:
* Just the thing for travelers who are always on the move who need to add an additional layer of
  security to a hotel room.
* Cheap, and the easiest to install of all the alarm systems.

Cons:
* Fairly basic security which only provides a local alarm in case of a break-in.
* Batteries need to be changed frequently.

### WIRELESS OR WIRED ALARMS?

[Intruder Alarm Installation UK]

How do you ascertain whether to opt for a wireless or wired burglar alarm, once you have decided
what your exact security needs are?

**Wired** - Generally, opting for a wired alarm system is more cost-effective than its wireless
counterpart, offering an equivalent level of security. However, the initial installation may incur
higher expenses due to the extensive labour involved in embedding the cables within your home. A
hard-wired alarm system boasts ease of maintenance and low operational costs, relying solely on
mains electricity to function efficiently. Regular upkeep is minimal, primarily involving the
cleaning of sensors and periodic checks of the battery backup in both the external bell box and the
control unit, following the schedule recommended by the alarm manufacturer. Nevertheless, if the
wiring is not meticulously concealed, it can detract from the aesthetic appeal of your home by
appearing unsightly.

**Wireless** - The cost of wireless alarm systems has significantly decreased from their initial
introduction, rendering them more affordable than they once were. Additionally, their installation
has become far simpler, allowing individuals with only fundamental DIY skills to set up a wireless
system with minimal hassle. To ensure optimal performance, it is advisable to keep a stock of
high-quality batteries available for the bell box and sensors, replacing them according to the
manufacturer's instructions for continued efficiency.

[[Quotes for Burglar Alarms in the UK]][149]

For the best results, always hire an established alarm installer to install and set-up your burglar
system. You can find numerous burglar alarm companies and installers in the UK area who'll help you
in selecting a system to meet your requirements.

A professional UK burglar alarm installer will carefully consider your requirements and provide
options that satisfy your needs. This will entail an on-site survey to determine any access points
which will need to be covered, along with improvements that could be made to existing window and
door locks if necessary.

Cannon System Design primarily serves **commercial clients**. However, we may take on **select

[list of things to do to deter unlawful individuals][33].

night time warning potential burglars that your alarm is Live! Always set your Alarm when your out
and in bed at night.

hopefully scare him away!

Have a least **2 Security Lights** on your property, One at the Front and One at the Rear. Lights
are a fantastic deterrent to unlawful individuals as they would prefer to carry out there criminal
activities in the dark!

break-in into your property.

or in your garden! These are perfect items that the burglar will use to help in committing his/her
crime!

protected property will make this individual think twice about committing a crime on your property.

## Frequently asked questions

What is POTS line replacement?
POTS (Plain Old Telephone Service) line replacement migrates legacy analog copper phone lines to IP
using cellular (5G/LTE) or wired backhaul. DataRemote's POTS IN A BOX® appliances connect your
existing analog devices — phones, fax, fire and burglar alarms, elevators — to RJ-11 ports and carry
their signals over a managed cellular network, preserving voice, FAX, DTMF and E-911.
Why do I need to replace my copper POTS lines now?
In 2025 the FCC streamlined copper retirement, cutting the shutdown notice period from 180 to 90
days, and AT&T stopped accepting new copper line orders on October 15, 2025. Carriers are raising
rates sharply — some POTS lines now exceed $2,700/line/month — and aim to retire copper nationwide
by 2029. Replacing now protects life-safety lines and controls cost.
Will my fire alarm, elevator phone and fax still work?
Yes. POTS IN A BOX® preserves the analog behaviors these devices depend on — DTMF signaling, line
seizure, supervision, ring-down and FAX — and includes E-911 with geo-location. The appliances are
designed specifically for life-safety and mission-critical analog endpoints.
What happens during a power or internet outage?
Each appliance includes an integrated lithium battery (up to 48 hours on the 90X1/90X2) and UPS
power output for approved external devices. Automatic cellular failover keeps lines connected even
if the primary internet circuit fails, so critical communications stay online.
How are DataRemote devices managed?
All DataRemote devices are managed through Ara, our device management platform for provisioning,
monitoring, live diagnostics and troubleshooting — with line-status alerts and a developer API for
system integration.

## Ready to retire your copper lines?

Talk to a DataRemote specialist about replacing your POTS lines before your carrier shuts copper
down.

## Frequently asked questions

What is POTS line replacement?
POTS (Plain Old Telephone Service) line replacement migrates legacy analog copper phone lines to IP
using cellular (5G/LTE) or wired backhaul. DataRemote's POTS IN A BOX® appliances connect your
existing analog devices — phones, fax, fire and burglar alarms, elevators — to RJ-11 ports and carry
their signals over a managed cellular network, preserving voice, FAX, DTMF and E-911.
Why do I need to replace my copper POTS lines now?
In 2025 the FCC streamlined copper retirement, cutting the shutdown notice period from 180 to 90
days, and AT&T stopped accepting new copper line orders on October 15, 2025. Carriers are raising
rates sharply — some POTS lines now exceed $2,700/line/month — and aim to retire copper nationwide
by 2029. Replacing now protects life-safety lines and controls cost.
Will my fire alarm, elevator phone and fax still work?
Yes. POTS IN A BOX® preserves the analog behaviors these devices depend on — DTMF signaling, line
seizure, supervision, ring-down and FAX — and includes E-911 with geo-location. The appliances are
designed specifically for life-safety and mission-critical analog endpoints.
What happens during a power or internet outage?
Each appliance includes an integrated lithium battery (up to 48 hours on the 90X1/90X2) and UPS
power output for approved external devices. Automatic cellular failover keeps lines connected even
if the primary internet circuit fails, so critical communications stay online.
How are DataRemote devices managed?
All DataRemote devices are managed through Ara, our device management platform for provisioning,
monitoring, live diagnostics and troubleshooting — with line-status alerts and a developer API for
system integration.

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this

July 11, 2026 • 2 weeks ago #209765

Hi again. I have two hydraulic valve packages, type Parker/Olsberg, with 4 valves in each package.
Now I’m helping my friend. I built a signal control switch with a changeover relay for the electric
control of the valves. The valves are controlled with current control. The problem is when I switch
to the second package, the system protests that there is an interruption in the coils. So I have to
restart the system again. I was wondering if I could change the relay to something else. Do you have
any tips on some type of switcher.

[Reply][38]
[Swagatam][39]Admin
July 13, 2026 • 2 weeks ago #209842

Hi, I do not think the relay itself is the main problem. The controller is probably checking the
valve coil current all the time, and during relay switching it sees an open circuit, so it gives the
coil interruption error. You may need a “make-before-break” type switch, or an electronic
MOSFET/solid-state switch that changes over without disconnecting the load. Can you tell me the coil
voltage, coil current, and the relay type you are using? A simple circuit may solve the problem.

[Reply][40]
Göran Axelsson
July 15, 2026 • 1 week ago #209955

Thanks for your reply. Here are your wishes about my problem. The relay I use is from Conrad Finder
40.52.9.024.0001 2 pole alternating 24 volts 8 Ampere. Valve voltage is proportional 24 volts
current is about 2 Ampere. The hydraulic valves are called Danfoss PVG 32.

[Reply][41]
[Swagatam][42]Admin
July 15, 2026 • 1 week ago #209962

Thanks for the details. I think the Finder relay is the reason for the problem. It is a normal
break-before-make relay so during switching both valve packages are disconnected for a short moment.
The Danfoss controller then sees an open coil and gives you the interruption error. I think you will
need a make-before-break switching circuit, or an electronic MOSFET/solid-state changeover which
keeps one valve connected until the other is connected. Another way could be to check if the Danfoss
controller has a setting to disable the coil monitoring during switching. That may also solve the
problem.

[Reply][43]
Göran Axelsson
July 19, 2026 • 5 days ago #210213

Do you have any alternative to another 2 pole changeover relay, possibly from Conrad? Greetings
Göran

[Reply][44]
[Swagatam][45]Admin
July 20, 2026 • 5 days ago #210235

A 2-pole changeover relay is simply a DPDT (Double-Pole Double-Throw) relay. On Conrad, you can find
them by filtering for “2 changeovers” (2 Wechsler).

Here are three alternatives they might have:

Finder 40.52 Series (8A rating, very common)
Omron G2R-2 Series (5A rating, industry standard)
Panasonic JW2SN Series (5A/8A rating, compact)

Just make sure to select the correct coil voltage (like 12VDC)

Hi Aygun,
if your machine uses a universal motor (with carbon brushes) or a specialized single-phase motor

But for a satellite dish vibration machine which I guess is used for testing how the dish handles

motor driven by a VFD with a single-phase input.

Thanks for the details. I think the Finder relay is the reason for the problem. It is a normal

At Logic Fire and Security we design, supply, install, commission and maintain fire detection
systems and electronic security systems throughout the UK.

## Keeping Businesses Safe, & Legal, For Over 20 Years

Logic Fire and Security provides complete fire and security solutions across the UK, offering expert
design, supply, installation, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance of advanced [fire detection
systems][44] and electronic security systems.

Our mission is to design success, build loyalty and maintain excellence, creating a caring and
visionary company. As a testament of our [commitment to excellence][45], we are NICEIC, BAFE and NSI
Gold approved contractors.

Some of the largest Blue Chip companies and Public agencies trust Logic Fire and Security to design,
install and maintain their fire safety and [security systems][46]. These Businesses and many more
depend on us to protect their buildings, stock, staff and customers round the clock.

## Our Process

At Logic Fire and Security, we follow a meticulous four-stage process that ensures your property
receives the highest standard of protection.

We begin with a comprehensive [**Assessment**][49], where our NICEIC, BAFE and NISI Gold certified
experts evaluate your premises, identify vulnerabilities, and understand your specific needs.

This is followed by our **Design** phase, where we create bespoke fire detection and security
solutions tailored to your requirements, leveraging cutting-edge technology while adhering to all
relevant regulations and industry standards.

Once your customised plan is approved, our skilled technicians handle the **Installation** with
minimal disruption to your operations, ensuring every component is precisely positioned for optimal
performance.

Our relationship continues long after installation through our [**Maintenance**][50] services, which
include regular inspections, preventative upkeep, and rapid response to any concerns.

This complete cycle reflects our mission to design success, build loyalty and maintain excellence,
providing your people and premises with reliable protection and peace of mind throughout the UK,
today and for years to come.

## Professionally Installed Burglar Alarms for Home Security Comfort

Midland Alarm Services install and maintain burglar alarms, CCTV and remote monitoring systems
across Coventry, Warwickshire and the wider Midlands areas. With over 38 years of experience, our
wireless HKC alarms give you instant app alerts, image verification and 24/7 protection - without

You're concerned that your current security measures might not be enough to deter skilled burglars.

You're unsure how to monitor your home effectively when you're away.

You worry that if an incident did arise, you wouldn’t be immediately aware of it.

You don't want to commit to lengthy contracts and high monthly fees that come with central
monitoring.

[Charles church new build Wixford home in kenilworth.jpeg]

## Why Choose Midland Alarm Services?
* Family-run Coventry security company, established 1987
* Specialists in wireless alarms, CCTV & SecureComm remote monitoring
* Insurance-approved systems, fitted by our own trusted engineers
* Free annual alarm health checks & firmware updates
* Local coverage across Warwickshire, Birmingham, Rugby & Nuneaton

safety. Our commitment to providing superior protection for our customer's homes has made us a
trusted name in the industry. Here’s how we solve your security concerns:

### Tailored Security Assessments

Led by Mick, our retired policeman and security expert, we begin with a free, no-obligation security
assessment of your property. Mick’s experienced eye helps identify specific vulnerabilities and
recommends solutions that fit your needs and budget.

[[HCK app visible with different functions shown on each phone]][38]

### Innovative Technology

Our [SecureComm app][39] allows you to monitor your home security remotely, giving you control and
the power to respond instantly, from anywhere in the world. Whether you're at work or on holiday,
peace of mind is at your fingertips.

[[image.webp]][40]

### Proactive Perimeter Protection

Unlike many of our competitors, we specialise in [perimeter protection][41] technology. This
proactive approach ensures that potential intruders are stopped before they even get into your home,
setting a new standard in home security.

## Profession [Alarm System Installation][42]

Our expert technicians, Kev and Sharpie, ensure that your [burglar alarm installation][43] process
is smooth and efficient. They respect your home as if it were their own, leaving no mess behind and
fully explaining how your new system works.

[[Burglar alarm being installed]][44]
[[alarm and family in safe home]][45]

### Continuous Support & Innovation

We believe in continuous improvement and support. With Midland Alarm Services, you are covered with
ongoing maintenance and support options, including our low-cost [remote monitoring plans][46],
ensuring your system remains at the cutting edge and function

FAQ

## You ask, we answer

Cloud Services
Cyber Security

Digital Transformation

IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting the world.

misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

Our mission is to support our clients with their security needs, and ensure that homes and
businesses across Sheffield, [Rotherham][14] and South Yorkshire as a whole are as safe as possible.

Fire Alarm and Extinguisher installation, and Fire Risk Assessments. All of these services, combined

Business Security

Fire Safety

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

infrastructure with secure **PABX and IP PBX communication networks** to ensure seamless operational
connectivity.

As a trusted **pad locks supplier in UAE** and the leading **pad locks supplier in Dubai**, we
engineer complete physical lock frameworks for high-risk environments. Our industrial inventory
features premium, corrosion-resistant **brass pad locks** and high-tensile **steel pad locks**
designed to withstand aggressive tampering and extreme coastal humidity. Built for harsh
environments, our heavy-duty **outdoor padlocks** guarantee long-term operational integrity. To
streamline corporate facility management, we customize these high-security, **heavy duty pad locks**
into scalable **master key pad locks** systems, allowing administrative oversight through a single,
secure key structure.

targeted lures and initial access.

attack surfaces, validating stolen credentials, and executing account takeover inside encrypted
traffic.
